title: Plant Builder in thirty seconds
about: A ~30-second explainer with burned-in captions. Invented product, company and systems (see README).

scenes.vo: Setting up a new plant usually means weeks of spreadsheets and email.
You describe the plant. Plant Builder drafts the settings and checks every value against your rules. Your team reviews the result, and only then does it move to the test system.

scenes.h1: Nothing moves until **your team signs off**.
scenes.vo: Nothing moves until your team signs off.
key: Nothing moves until your team signs off.
